Voter registration is available daily at the Town Clerk’s Office, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Voters may also register online through the Massachusetts Secretary of State’s website, at www.mass.gov/topics/voting.

Vote by Mail and Absentee Voting

Applications for Vote by Mail and Absentee Ballots are available on the Town of Norwood website under the Town Clerk’s section, at https://www.norwoodma.gov/departments/town_clerk/voting_and_elections/index.php. Applications must be received in order for a ballot to be mailed.

The deadline to apply for a Vote by Mail or Absentee Ballot to be mailed is Monday, March 30, 2026. No applications will be accepted after that date.

The deadline for in-person absentee voting is Friday, April 3, 2026, at 12:00 p.m.
